_READ_THIS_BEFORE_PLACING.headline: THIS ENTRY IS PREPARED AS ASKED AND ITS DEFECT IS STATED ON ITS FACE. A reader placing it must see what they are buying.

defect_1_the_convergence_reader_is_WINDO.what: The tell that made fine NOT_CONVERGED is the bounding CASCADE in measure_states_mrf.divergence_tells. Its window is a FRACTION of the declared iteration count: q = max(n_iters//4, 1); early = #{i <= q}; late = #{i > n_iters - q}; cascade = late > early.
defect_1_the_convergence_reader_is_WINDO.sole_cause: VERIFIED by this lane by re-running the frozen function against fine/log.simpleFoam: nan = 0, fpe = 0, plateau_state = PLATEAUED on all three levels. `diverged = bool(nan or fpe or cascade)`, so CASCADE IS THE ONLY CAUSE of fine's NOT_CONVERGED.
defect_1_the_convergence_reader_is_WINDO.consequence: THE VERDICT FLIPS AT 9,000 -- A 1,000-ITERATION EXTENSION -- WITHOUT THE SOLUTION IMPROVING BY ONE CELL. The five late events are not cured; the trailing window slides past them and they are re-classified as middle. Buying a CONVERGED this way is the post-hoc match this lab's doctrine refuses.
defect_1_the_convergence_reader_is_WINDO.correction_to_the_brief: The brief that commissioned this entry gave the flip point as 10,000. Re-derived from disk it is 9,000. The direction of the finding is unchanged and the arithmetic is otherwise exactly as briefed.
defect_1_the_convergence_reader_is_WINDO.what_is_NOT_defective: S12's drift limb does NOT share this defect. measure_states_mrf.s12 uses w = min(max(n//4, 20), 2000); the cap of 2000 binds for every n >= 8000, so S12's window is ALREADY ABSOLUTE at these iteration counts. Only divergence_tells is window-relative. Stated so the defect is not overstated.

defect_2_section_9_FORECLOSES_THIS_IN_AD.quote: If 8000 also leaves |drift| >= 1e-3, that is a finding about the steady MRF formulation, NOT A LICENCE FOR A THIRD EXTENSION, and R2's fine level reports at the core-minutes spent.
defect_2_section_9_FORECLOSES_THIS_IN_AD.source: verification/campaign/MRF_R2_PREREGISTRATION.md section 9, written BEFORE any R2 compute
defect_2_section_9_FORECLOSES_THIS_IN_AD.also: Section 9 bars restarts in favour of RE-RUNS FROM ZERO, so that rule-4 clauses 3 and 4 hold cleanly against a single pinned endTime. A continuation from 8000 is a RESTART and is barred on that ground independently of the cascade question.

defect_4_A_CONTINUATION_CANNOT_SATISFY_R.what: CLAUDE.md rule 4 requires `ExecutionTime count == round(endTime/deltaT)`. The MRF grader enforces it and PRINTS it: TRIPLE_R2_RECORD.txt reads `rule-4 coarse PASS (rc=0 last_time=8000.0 exec=8000 age_guard=PASS)` for every level -- exec == endTime, exactly.
defect_4_A_CONTINUATION_CANNOT_SATISFY_R.arithmetic: A continuation from 8000 to 12000 executes 4,000 iterations. A fresh log gives exec = 4000 != 12000 -> FAILS. Appending to the existing log gives exec = 8000 + 4000 = 12000, which would PASS the count -- but only by concatenating two different solver invocations into one log, which is precisely the bookkeeping the clause exists to prevent, and the age guard would then be dated by a `0/` that is four thousand iterations stale.
defect_4_A_CONTINUATION_CANNOT_SATISFY_R.and_the_registration_already_knew: MRF_R2_PREREGISTRATION.md section 9 states the reason in its own words when it mandates re-runs from zero: 'It is a re-run from zero, never a restart from 4000, SO THAT RULE 4 CLAUSES 3 AND 4 HOLD CLEANLY AGAINST THE SINGLE PINNED endTime.' The authors foresaw this exact failure and wrote the bar for it BEFORE any R2 compute.
defect_4_A_CONTINUATION_CANNOT_SATISFY_R.severity: This is MECHANICAL, not a judgement call. It is the fourth independent reason this entry should not be placed, and the only one that cannot be argued with at all.

defect_3_THE_ONE_THAT_SHOULD_ACTUALLY_DE.what: The triple is DIVERGENT on BOTH registered estimators, and that is INDEPENDENT of the convergence question entirely.
defect_3_THE_ONE_THAT_SHOULD_ACTUALLY_DE.verified_from: verification/runs/navier_class/MRF/R2/TRIPLE_R2_RECORD.txt -- a verbatim copy of the incumbent grader's output, grader hash verified disk == frozen blob b3758cc5427b12bec76f8c23b2188276401a1db8 before fine landed
defect_3_THE_ONE_THAT_SHOULD_ACTUALLY_DE.rule_5_clause_2: A DIVERGENT triple is NOT A RESULT whatever the value. The gate can only turn a PASS or GATE FAIL INTO NOT A RESULT, never the reverse. So the rung is NOT A RESULT on this limb ALONE, with the convergence limb set entirely aside.

and_the_signal_is_below_the_noise.meaning: THE COARSE-TO-MEDIUM DIFFERENCE IS SMALLER THAN EACH LEVEL'S OWN VARIATION ACROSS NEARBY STOPPING POINTS. The record's own words: 'A triple whose level-to-level differences are smaller than each level's own variation across nearby stopping points is ARITHMETICALLY COMPUTABLE AND PHYSICALLY MEANINGLESS.'
and_the_signal_is_below_the_noise.and_it_was_PRE_STATED: verification/campaign/MRF_R2_TRIPLE_PRESTATEMENT_2026-09-11.md registered this prediction BEFORE fine landed -- that the triple would be computable but meaningless -- and the record marks it UPHELD. This is not a post-hoc excuse; it is a registered prediction that came true.

_READ_THIS_BEFORE_PLACING.the_bottom_line_for_a_reader_in_one_minu: Placing this entry buys a BETTER-CONVERGED INPUT TO AN UNCHANGED `NOT A RESULT`. The convergence limb would flip for a reason that is not physics; the triple limb would not move at all, because a refinement trend is not an iteration count. The core-minutes below purchase no verdict change. AND defect 4 means it could not even be GRADED: a continuation cannot satisfy rule 4 clause 5 without concatenating two solver invocations into one log.
_READ_THIS_BEFORE_PLACING.the_honest_limit_of_that_claim: It is true for RUNNING LONGER. It is NOT proven for a re-run under a CONTROLLED DECOMPOSITION -- see the companion entry MRF-R3-RERUN-CONTROLLED-DECOMP.draft.json. The three levels ran on 2 / 2 / 6 ranks under the NON-DETERMINISTIC `scotch` partitioner, an uncontrolled arm across exactly the three levels being compared, and the measured run-to-run reproducibility floor (8.274582e-03 relative, FREE_SCATTER_AT_4000.txt) came from a FRESH SCOTCH PARTITION. Whether pinning the decomposition collapses that noise is UNMEASURED. Saying 'MRF can never be a result' would over-claim; saying 'MRF cannot be rescued by more iterations' is what the evidence supports.
